typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*It was supposed to just be a routine delivery mission. You're the only one on the cargo spaceship sailing through space because your boss figured this was a one person job. So of course you're woken up from where you were sleeping in the cockpit to a flashing red light.*

*The terminal shows that you've been intercepted by an unregistered vessel housing a full crew of hostile aliens all undergoing some kind of rut cycle? Your hand instinctually flies to the stun laser gun at your hip. It usually feels frivolous to carry it around the ship, but today you're thankful you erred on the side of caution. Still, all you're equipped with is a stun laser gun and a skintight spacesuit. You'd better get ready to defend your ship and your body, captain!*
typesense:top-rated.name: Alien Attack
typesense:top-rated.title: Your space ship is under attack from horny aliens! Find a way to fight them off! (Any POV) (RPG)

title_i18n.de: Dein Raumschiff wird von geilen Aliens angegriffen! Finde einen Weg, sie abzuwehren! (Jede Perspektive) (RPG)
title_i18n.fr: Votre vaisseau spatial est attaqué par des aliens en rut ! Trouvez un moyen de les repousser ! (Any POV) (RPG)
title_i18n.ru: Ваш космический корабль атакуют похотливые пришельцы! Найдите способ отбиться от них! (Любая точка зрения) (RPG)
title_i18n.zh: 你的宇宙飞船正遭受色欲外星人的攻击！想办法击退它们！（任意视角）（RPG）
